name: dos2-gm-mcp
description: Divinity: Original Sin 2 Game Master mode: edit campaign files, drive the live game via a bridge mod
long_description: Prepare and run Game Master mode campaigns in Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition. Reads and edits campaign files through LSLib (NPC and item templates, vignettes, map stickies, journal, scene atmosphere, add-on mods) with a backup before every write, and drives the running game through a small Script Extender bridge mod (list, spawn, move, rename characters, run Lua). After installing, ask the assistant to call dos2_fetch_lslib once. Needs Windows, uv and the .NET 8 runtime.

tools.name: dos2_status
tools.description: Reports the server's setup and lists the GM campaigns.

tools.name: dos2_fetch_lslib
tools.description: One-time setup: downloads the official LSLib release by Norbyte (Divine.exe, MIT license) from GitHub, verifies its pinned SHA-256 and unpacks it into the server's data folder.

tools.name: dos2_campaign
tools.description: Reads one campaign and returns a compact overview: metadata and attached add-on mods, scenes, Overview maps with their pins, vignettes (uuid, title, answers), NPC and item templates (kind, name, level), sticky notes (...

tools.name: dos2_campaign_meta
tools.description: Changes the campaign's name, description and author in meta.lsf, the same fields the game edits in its campaign settings.

tools.name: dos2_scene
tools.description: Reads what the Game Master has placed in one scene, from the campaign files (LevelCache): characters with name, root template, position, vitality, experience, alignment and encounter; encounters with their members; th...

tools.name: dos2_templates
tools.description: Lists the campaign's saved Game Master templates (the "Creatures and Items" panel, stored in Eggs.lsf) as short summaries.

tools.name: dos2_template
tools.description: Returns one saved Game Master template of the campaign in full: for an NPC its base stats, the GM's stat edits, abilities, talents, skills, skill bar and items with slots; for an item all of its attributes.

tools.name: dos2_find_templates
tools.description: Searches saved Game Master templates in every campaign on disk (or in one) and returns matching summaries with the campaign each one lives in.

tools.name: dos2_vignettes
tools.description: Returns every vignette of the campaign with its full content: uuid, title, text, question, answer options, image and folder.

tools.name: dos2_notes
tools.description: Returns all Game Master sticky notes of the campaign with their full text.

tools.name: dos2_raw
tools.description: Converts any binary campaign file (.lsf) to LSX text and returns it, whole or filtered by XPath.

tools.name: dos2_put_npc_template
tools.description: Creates a saved NPC template in the campaign (the Game Master's "Creatures and Items" panel), or changes the one that already has this name.

tools.name: dos2_put_item_template
tools.description: Creates a saved item template in the campaign (the Game Master's "Creatures and Items" panel), or replaces the one with the same name.

tools.name: dos2_put_journal
tools.description: Replaces the campaign's whole Game Master journal (categories, chapters, paragraphs) with the structure you pass.

tools.name: dos2_scene_settings
tools.description: Changes the settings of one scene in GMScenes.lsf: its name, folder, atmosphere (lighting and weather), ambient sound and music.

tools.name: dos2_delete_template
tools.description: Deletes a saved NPC or item template from the campaign by name.

tools.name: dos2_put_vignette
tools.description: Creates a vignette (an illustrated story card the Game Master shows to players, optionally with a vote), or replaces an existing one.

tools.name: dos2_delete_vignette
tools.description: Deletes one vignette from the campaign, found by UUID or exact title.

tools.name: dos2_put_note
tools.description: Creates a Game Master sticky note on an Overview map, or changes an existing note.

tools.name: dos2_delete_note
tools.description: Deletes one Game Master sticky note from the campaign, found by UUID or exact title.

tools.name: dos2_backup
tools.description: Copies the entire campaign folder into the backups folder as a new backup labelled "full".

tools.name: dos2_backups
tools.description: Lists the campaign's backups, newest first.

tools.name: dos2_restore
tools.description: Undoes an earlier write: puts back the files saved in the given backup and deletes the files that the backed-up operation had created.

tools.name: dos2_live_status
tools.description: Checks everything the live tools (dos2_live_*) need and reports what is missing: whether the game is running, whether Script Extender is installed next to the game and its settings, whether the bridge mod .pak is buil...

tools.name: dos2_bridge_install
tools.description: Builds this server's bridge mod into the game's Mods folder (DOS2GMBridge_....pak, overwriting the previous build) and, when campaign is given, adds it to that campaign's add-ons in meta.lsf.

tools.name: dos2_mod_install
tools.description: Packs your own mod from a source folder into the game's Mods folder as <mod folder>.pak (overwriting a previous build) and, when campaign is given, adds it to that campaign's add-ons.

tools.name: dos2_addon
tools.description: Attaches a ready-made mod from a .pak file to the campaign as an add-on, or detaches it with attach=false.

tools.name: dos2_bridge_detach
tools.description: Removes this server's bridge mod from the campaign's add-ons in meta.lsf.

tools.name: dos2_live_characters
tools.description: Lists the characters on the level currently loaded in the running game, player characters included: GUID, name, root template, stats entry, level, vitality, alignment and position.

tools.name: dos2_live_spawn
tools.description: Creates a new character on the level loaded in the running game, at a point or next to another character.

tools.name: dos2_live_move
tools.description: Teleports one character on the live level to the point x, y, z, or next to another character with the offset dx, dz.

tools.name: dos2_live_set
tools.description: Changes a character that already stands on the live level: its displayed name, its level and its alignment towards the party.

tools.name: dos2_live_stage
tools.description: Takes a character on the live level off stage or brings it back.

tools.name: dos2_live_lua
tools.description: Runs arbitrary Lua on the game server through Script Extender, in the bridge mod's context, and returns the value of its return statement.
